children: An Altria buyout of smaller London-listed peer Imperial Brands would be logical and highly likely to proceed, Citi's Simon Hales and Sunny Wadhwani write. The Marlboro cigarette maker said it was considering an all-cash bid for the company behind the Davidoff and Gauloises. Because Altria only operates in the U.S. with a limited exposure to next-generation products, buying Imperial Brands would diversify its traditional cigarette business while expanding its lineup of heated tobacco, vapes, and oral nicotine produts, the analysts say. Citi has a neutral rating on Altria's stock and a $72 target price. Shares are down 2.5% at $74.39 in premarket trading. (ian.walker@wsj.com)
